chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAbdillāh al-Arrajānī narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
"Whoever prays in his mosque, then goes to one of their mosques and prays with them, he departs with their good deeds."

key_terms.بِحَسَنَاتِهِمْ: with their good deeds, meaning their reward

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying in one’s own mosque and then praying with others in their mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages a person to perform salat in his own mosque and then join others in their mosque in prayer. It indicates a spiritual reward in participating with them, expressed as leaving with their good deeds.
